description: Confirm the TypeScript gate passes with no type errors on the current tree.
execute_notes: This is a read-only check. Nothing to build, just run the compiler in no-emit mode.

description: Count the customer portal page routes under src/app/portal and confirm there are exactly 3 (the quote view, the approved view, and the pay-balance view).
execute_notes: Read-only grep, no code changes. If the count ever drifts from 3, that is a signal the portal route surface changed and the number in this task needs updating, not a repo bug.

verify.command: test "$(find src/app/portal -type f \( -name page.tsx -o -name route.ts \) | wc -l)" -eq 3

description: Confirm package.json still defines the lint, test, and build scripts the gates depend on.
execute_notes: Read-only check of package.json content, no install or build triggered.

verify.command: node -e "const s=require('./package.json').scripts||{}; const need=['lint','test','build']; const missing=need.filter(k=>!s[k]); if(missing.length){console.error('missing scripts: '+missing.join(', ')); process.exit(1);} console.log('all required scripts present');"
